message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Earnings Acceleration", "construction": "Difference between the most recent quarter's year-over-year earnings growth rate and the previous quarter's year-over-year earnings growth rate, using Compustat quarterly earnings data.", "rationale": "Firms with accelerating earnings growth may signal improved fundamentals not yet reflected in prices.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Growth Surprise", "construction": "Current quarter's inventory growth (change in inventories/sales) minus average inventory growth over the prior eight quarters, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Negative inventory surprises may indicate leaner operations or stronger demand than anticipated.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Intra-Industry Valuation Gap", "construction": "Firm's price-to-book ratio minus median price-to-book ratio of its industry (using CRSP and Compustat), updated annually.", "rationale": "Firms trading at deep valuation discounts to industry peers may be undervalued due to investor overreaction.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Omission Indicator", "construction": "Dummy variable indicating whether a firm that paid dividends in the previous year omits a dividend in the current year, from CRSP distribution records.", "rationale": "Dividend omissions may signal distress not fully reflected in price, or conversely, omitting dividends to reinvest may boost future growth.", "higher_returns_for": "firms that recently omitted dividends"}, {"name": "Operating Cash Flow to Total Assets", "construction": "Ratio of annual operating cash flow (Compustat OANCF) to total assets, calculated at fiscal year-end.", "rationale": "High cash flow relative to assets may indicate stronger underlying profitability and financial stability.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D Intensity Change", "construction": "Year-over-year change in R&D expenses divided by sales (Compustat XRD/Sale), measured annually.", "rationale": "Increasing R&D intensity may predict future innovation and earnings growth unrecognized by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with recent increases in R&D intensity"}, {"name": "Share Issuance Activity", "construction": "Percentage change in shares outstanding over the prior 12 months, using CRSP shares outstanding data.", "rationale": "Issuing equity may signal overvaluation or poor future prospects, while low or negative issuance may be positive.", "higher_returns_for": "low or negative values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net PP&E Investment Rate", "construction": "Annual change in net property, plant, and equipment (PP&E) divided by average total assets over the year, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with high investment rates may be overconfident and overinvesting, while low investors may be more disciplined.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Percentage change in number of employees from prior fiscal year, using Compustat data where available.", "rationale": "Rapid expansion in headcount may be associated with overoptimism or future cost pressures.", "higher_returns_for": "low or modest values of the measure"}, {"name": "Receivables-to-Sales Ratio", "construction": "Accounts receivable divided by sales (Compustat), measured annually.", "rationale": "High receivables relative to sales may indicate aggressive revenue recognition or deteriorating credit quality.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}]}
